title: Implement time-aware prompt-anchor rollback orchestrator and prioritized adversarial prober CI gate
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We observed a class of regressions where prompt-set failures are transiently correlated with recent rollout traffic patterns and adversarial surface probes. Existing static-anchor gating catches some regressions but misses time-localized degradations and does not prioritize prompts by adversarial susceptibility. This PR implements a time-aware prompt-anchor orchestration layer plus a prioritized adversarial prober and hooks the combined signal into the CI gating pipeline. Scope: (1) time-aware anchor snapshots (hourly/day window anchoring + TTL and decay), (2) prioritized adversarial prober that generates targeted perturbations and ranks prompts by failure volatility, (3) orchestrator that computes an importance-weighted regression score across anchors and adversarial probes and emits actionable failure reasons, (4) CI gate integration with configurable thresholds and automatic rollback trigger metadata. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked and reviewed - [x] Core implementation (orchestrator, prober, anchor store) - [x] Unit tests for anchoring window logic - [x] Integration tests for prober prioritization - [x] CI pipeline updates and canary simulation - [x] Docs and runbook for on-call remediation - [x] Backward-compatible config flags and feature gate Usage notes: The gate can be enabled per-prompt-set via eval-config.yaml. By default it runs in soft-fail mode (annotates PR and posts a detailed failure artifact). When set to hard-fail it will block merges and produce a rollback suggestion payload compatible with rollout automation. Observability: New telemetry exported: eval.anchor.delta, eval.prober.flakiness_rank, eval.gate.weighted_score, eval.rollout.suggested_action. Migration: Old anchor snapshots remain readable; new hourly snapshots are opt-in via feature flag until 2026-01-01. See docs/eval/anchor_strategy.md for operator guidance.

review_comments: Priya Nair: Overall design looks solid. Please add a short note in the runbook about feature-flag migration behavior to avoid surprises when we flip to hard-fail.
Maya Chen (author): Added migration note and example config that shows the soft->hard transition behavior. Also added a telemetry event for 'gate.mode_change' so on-call can audit flips.
Diego Salazar: The prioritizer sampling seed needs deterministic replay for CI flakiness debugging — can we expose a fixed-seed path?
Maya Chen (author): Exposed deterministic seed via EVAL_PROBER_SEED env var and added tests to validate deterministic behavior in CI runs.
Evan Brooks: Suggest reducing default hourly anchor retention to 72 hours to reduce storage; operators can opt into longer history if needed.
Maya Chen (author): Lowered default retention to 72 hours and documented tradeoffs in anchor_strategy.md. Kept config knob for longer retention.
release_notes: Adds a time-aware anchor + adversarial prober CI gate that detects transient, time-localized prompt-set regressions and can suggest automatic rollback payloads. Backward compatible behind a feature flag. Includes operator docs and telemetry for evaluation and on-call workflows.
